### Finding 1

**title:** `AttrPreset::All` captures zero attributes

**body:** `AttrPreset::names()` returns an empty slice for `All`, and `SniffConfig::effective_attributes()` has no special case — the engine extraction JS (`extractor.rs:758`) only calls `el.getAttribute(name)` for each name in that list, with no `getAttributeNames()` branch or `allAttributes` opt. So `--attrs-preset all` (and MCP `attrs_preset:"all"`) is a silent no-op, directly contradicting the documented "lê `getAttributeNames()`" behavior in `docs/usage.md:122`. The `All` variant is newly introduced by this patch and has no consumer-side dispatch anywhere.

**priority:** 2  
**confidence:** 0.97  
**file_path:** `crates/sniff-core/src/config.rs`  
**line_start:** 231  
**line_end:** 235

```suggestion
    pub fn names(self) -> &'static [&'static str] {
        match self {
            // `All` is handled by the extraction engine via getAttributeNames().
            Self::None | Self::All => &[],
```

Add to `SniffConfig`:
```rust
    pub fn all_attributes(&self) -> bool {
        !self.minimal && self.attr_preset == AttrPreset::All
    }
```
and in `extractor.rs:881` opts add `"allAttributes": config.all_attributes(),`, then in the JS at line 758 branch on `opts.allAttributes` to iterate `el.getAttributeNames()`.

### Finding 2

**title:** MCP `viewport_matrix` parameter is dead; MCP never produces a matrix

**body:** `SniffPageRequest.viewport_matrix` is parsed into `config.matrix_viewports` (`server.rs:1179-1188`, `:1282`), but MCP capture goes through `ChromePool::sniff_with` → `sniff_session_with_progress` (`browser.rs:118`), which only reads `config.emulate`/`config.viewport` and never `matrix_viewports` or `matrix_emulations`. Thus the new MCP parameter has no effect, MCP snapshots contain no `__meta.matrix`, and the documented default "12-state matrix / cross-state checks" never happens on that surface. `emulate` itself does apply (single state), so only the matrix promise is broken.

**priority:** 2  
**confidence:** 0.96  
**file_path:** `crates/sniff-css-mcp/src/server.rs`  
**line_start:** 1179  
**line_end:** 1188

Minimal fix: route MCP web capture through the same matrix-expanding path used by `commands/capture.rs::sniff_with_matrix` (move that helper into `sniff-engine` so both surfaces call it), or remove the dead `viewport_matrix` parameter until matrix support exists in the pool.

### Finding 3

**title:** MCP check uses full document as baseline, duplicating node checks

**body:** CLI narrows node-level checks to the first matrix state via `baseline_document()` and calls `run_modern_checks_for(&doc, &baseline_doc, &opts)` (`commands/check.rs:116,196`). MCP instead calls `run_modern_checks(&nodes, &ModernOptions::default())` (`server.rs:1030`), which is `run_modern_checks_for(doc, doc, opts)`; it also runs `run_rules`/`check_uniformity` on all of `nodes.nodes` (`:985`, `:993`). Loading a CLI-captured 12-state snapshot into `sniff_check` therefore emits each node-level finding up to 12 times and cross-contaminates uniformity groups — different output from the CLI for the same file.

**priority:** 2  
**confidence:** 0.92  
**file_path:** `crates/sniff-css-mcp/src/server.rs`  
**line_start:** 1029  
**line_end:** 1032

```suggestion
        if request.modern {
            let lines = sniff_css_check::run_modern_checks_for(&nodes, &baseline, &ModernOptions::default());
```
with `let baseline = /* first-state narrowing, same as commands/check.rs::baseline_document */;` computed before the rules/uniformity/modern blocks and used for `&nodes.nodes` there too.

### Finding 4

**title:** Serde defaults contradict `Default` for three v2 config fields

**body:** `declared_facet`, `matrix_viewports`, and `matrix_emulations` carry `#[serde(default)]` (lines 109/115/121), which yields `false`, `[]`, `[]` on deserialization, while `impl Default for SniffConfig` sets `true`, two viewports, and four profiles (lines 165/168/169) and all docs promise v2 context ON by default. `SniffConfig` is a public `Deserialize` type; any consumer deserializing a pre-v0.6 JSON config (or a config that omits these keys) silently gets the old single-state behaviour, breaking the documented contract. The `declared_facet` doc comment even still says "opt-in", matching the wrong serde default.

**priority:** 2  
**confidence:** 0.95  
**file_path:** `crates/sniff-core/src/config.rs`  
**line_start:** 107  
**line_end:** 123

```suggestion
    #[serde(default = "default_true")]
    pub declared_facet: bool,
    /// Limite de regras CSSOM coletadas.
    #[serde(default = "default_declared_limit")]
    pub declared_limit: usize,
    /// Emulações pedidas (`prefers-color-scheme=dark`, etc.), em ordem chave.
    #[serde(default)]
    pub emulate: std::collections::BTreeMap<String, String>,
    /// Viewports adicionais da matriz; vazio = captura única (N=1).
    #[serde(default = "default_matrix_viewports")]
    pub matrix_viewports: Vec<Viewport>,
    /// Perfis de emulação da matriz. Cada perfil é combinado com cada viewport.
    #[serde(default = "default_matrix_emulations")]
    pub matrix_emulations: Vec<std::collections::BTreeMap<String, String>>,
```

### Finding 5

**title:** Prime full protocol lists `--no-responsive` under `sniff capture`

**body:** The capture verb synopsis in `PRIME_FULL` ends with `[--no-visible --no-aria --no-contrast --no-ax --no-responsive ...]`, but `--no-responsive` is defined only on `CheckArgs` (`cli/check.rs:66`) and passing it to `sniff capture` fails with an unexpected-argument error. An agent following `sniff prime --long` verbatim will emit an invalid command. The flag is correctly listed under `sniff check` on line 72; line 67 is the patch-introduced mistake.

### Finding 6

**title:** MCP action factory rejects the new `key` action

**body:** `parse_action` gained a `key` branch (`config.rs:958-980`) and the engine handles `Action::Key` (`action.rs:51,146`; `effects.rs`; `sniffer.rs`), but MCP builds actions through its own `action_from_input` match, which only accepts `click|hover|type|upload` and errors on anything else (`server.rs:1341-1345`). Consequently `{"type":"key"}` cannot be dispatched through `sniff_page`, while the shared protocol block and prime text advertise `key:Escape` as the native-dialog dismissal mechanism. This is a missed consumer-side branch for a patch-introduced enum variant.

**priority:** 3  
**confidence:** 0.9  
**file_path:** `crates/sniff-css-mcp/src/server.rs`  
**line_start:** 1301  
**line_end:** 1345

```suggestion

            let key = input
                .text
                .clone()
                .ok_or_else(|| "key action requires `text` (the CDP key name)".to_string())?;
            Ok(Action::Key { key, timeout_ms, settle_ms })
        }
```
(extend the error message to include `key`, and document the new input shape on `ActionInput`).
